script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Sports
Theme: forgiveness

Begin screenplay.

Title: GAME CHANGER

INT. HIGH SCHOOL GYM - EARLY MORNING

COACH SIMMONS (50s, stern, with a heart of gold) enters the gym, his eyes scanning the empty room. He puts on his headphones and turns on the radio. The music plays as he begins to stretch.

COACH SIMMONS
(voiceover)
Another day, another chance to change lives.

Suddenly, the doors burst open, and in walks PRINCE (17, tall, athletic, troubled), who throws a basketball carelessly onto the floor.

PRINCE
(shrugs)
Another day, Coach.

Coach Simmons looks up, his eyes full of disappointment.

INT. HIGH SCHOOL GYM - LATER

The team gathers for practice, and Prince takes his usual spot on the bench. COACH SIMMONS addresses the team.

COACH SIMMONS
I know some of you may be thinking, "Why bother?" But remember, every one of you has the potential to be a game changer. It's up to you to decide if you want to use that power for good or for destruction.

INT. HIGH SCHOOL CLASSROOM - DAY

Prince sits next to LUCY (17, petite, smart, compassionate), who is working on her laptop. She notices that Prince has a stack of detention slips.

LUCY
(smiling)
Another detention? You're racking them up, aren't you?

PRINCE
(sarcastically)
Yeah, just collecting them like baseball cards.

Lucy looks concerned.

LUCY
You know Coach Simmons cares about you, right? He doesn't give you detention out of spite. He wants to help you.

Prince rolls his eyes.

INT. HIGH SCHOOL CAFETERIA - DAY

The team gathers for lunch, and Prince sits alone, ignoring everyone. LUCY approaches him.

LUCY
(sitting down next to him)
I heard about your mom. I'm really sorry, Prince.

Prince looks surprised.

PRINCE
How did you know?

LUCY
Word travels fast. I just want you to know that if you ever need to talk, I'm here for you.

Prince nods, and they sit in silence for a moment.

INT. HIGH SCHOOL GYM - LATE AFTERNOON

The team is practicing their free throws. PRINCE misses his first few shots, and Coach Simmons walks over.

COACH SIMMONS
(puts a hand on Prince's shoulder)
You know, Prince, the ball doesn't know if you're angry or sad. It just wants you to shoot it straight.

Prince looks up, surprised.

PRINCE
What do you mean?

COACH SIMMONS
(smiling)
Just like in life. You can't control the circumstances, but you can control how you react to them.

Prince takes a deep breath and shoots the ball, making the basket.

INT. HIGH SCHOOL CLASSROOM - EVENING

Prince stays after class to work on a project with LUCY. They talk about their pasts and share their struggles.

LUCY
(smiling)
You know, I used to think I was a lost cause too. But then I met Coach Simmons, and he showed me that it's never too late to change.

Prince looks at her, his expression softening.

PRINCE
I guess I'm just a lost cause.

LUCY
(placing a hand on his)
No, you're not. You have the power to be a game changer, just like Coach Simmons said. But you have to be willing to accept help and forgive yourself.

Prince looks thoughtful.

INT. HIGH SCHOOL GYM - NIGHT

The team is practicing, and Prince takes the court for the first time in weeks. He shoots hoop after hoop, missing some but making most.

COACH SIMMONS
(proudly)
That's the Prince I know.

Prince turns to him, a small smile playing on his lips.

PRINCE
I'm back, Coach.

INT. HIGH SCHOOL GYM - LATER

The team gathers around Coach Simmons, who hands out trophies for their recent win. Prince receives his trophy, and for the first time in a long time, he feels a sense of pride.

PRINCE
(looking at Coach Simmons)
Thank you, Coach. For everything.

COACH SIMMONS
(smiling)
You're welcome, Prince. Now go out there and be a game changer.

Fade out.

END OF SCREENPLAY.
